missingValues.csv: Empty value cell plus the <var>__state column. No numeric missing codes (such as -99) are ever written.
missingValues.json: value null plus state per answer.

saveMode.implications: Answers were saved to the server on every page change. Partial sessions exist on the server, so drop-outs are visible to the researcher, but this export holds only submitted responses.
